name: botpay
stderr:
Usage: botpay [options] [command]

Production CLI for free x402 discovery and direct Agent wallet payments

Options:
  -V, --version                output the version number
  --json                       Emit stable JSON envelopes
  --quiet                      Suppress human-readable command output
  --no-color                   Disable terminal colors
  --profile <name>             BotPay account profile
  --workspace <id>             BotPay workspace override
  --project <id>               BotPay project override
  --verbose                    Include diagnostic error details
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]              Authorize this CLI as a BotPay Scan account
                               device
  whoami|account               Show the active BotPay account
  logout [options]             Revoke this CLI device and remove local
                               credentials
  profile                      Manage local BotPay account profiles
  device                       Manage authorized BotPay CLI devices
  workspace                    Manage the active BotPay workspace
  project                      Manage the active BotPay project
  token                        Manage project and service API tokens
  services [options]           List BotPay-owned services without marketplace
                               search
  agent                        Install BotPay integrations for Agent clients
  wallet                       Manage the local Agent wallet
  config                       Inspect or update non-secret configuration
  credits                      BotPay Credits utilities
  bazaar                       Official x402 Bazaar access unlocked by a
                               successful BotPay /pay purchase
  discover [options] <origin>  Read /openapi.json or /.well-known/x402 directly
                               from an origin
  check [options] <url>        Inspect an endpoint from free origin discovery;
                               --probe performs a live unpaid request
  call [options] <url>         Call an endpoint directly; x402 payment is
                               allowed only with --yes
  plan [options] <service>     Build a BotPay service payment plan without
                               paying
  execute [options] <service>  Execute a BotPay service with constrained x402
                               payment
  go                           Use the paid BotPay /go access receipt to connect
                               the guarded exchange MCP
  voucher                      Escrow voucher commands
  refund [options]             Return the local Agent wallet's Base USDC
                               balance; Voucher Treasury is never used
  doctor                       Check runtime, wallet permissions, Bazaar access,
                               and BotPay origins
  mcp                          Run the BotPay Model Context Protocol server over
                               stdio
  help [command]               display help for command
BotPay USAGE_ERROR: (outputHelp)
